description: Lower-level code for managing internal flash memory operations such as sector size calculation, erasing, reading, writing, and locking/unlocking flash memory.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a given flash sector based on its index.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Returns the starting address of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Returns the ending address of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determines which flash sector contains a given address.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erases a specified range of flash memory.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into flash memory.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Checks if a range of flash memory is erased (all bits set to 1).

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compares flash memory contents with a buffer.
